_doc: The numbers of weapon targeting, point defence, the fleet and the tactical map (src/Core/Data/SystemsDef.Tactical.cs reads them; openspec/changes/weapon-targeting/design.md), ported from the battle console mockup's STRIKE, SYS_POS, hitChance, AI_RETREAT and the map's scales (docs/mockups/battle-console.html). strike: where a hit lands (owner, 2026-11-04: "most weapons like torpedos hit based on arc receiving the hit ... where as EMPs and phasers and disruptors had a better chance of delivering the direct hit on stuff, but would damage other systems on rthe current arc as well (like a 50/50 spred)"). A hit through a facing reaches the subsystems and mounts within reach_deg of the facing's centre, and anything within internal_half_len half-lengths of the middle: the chopping block. A precise weapon's hit lands on the aimed subsystem or mount direct_chance of the time when the block holds it; any other hit damages a random block subsystem spread_chance of the time. Every hit damages a random exposed mount mount_chance of the time (plus mount_aim_chance for a direct hit aimed at weapons control), taking mount_hit_frac of its health. A subsystem loses sys_per_dmg of its health a point through the shields, the reactor reactor_per_dmg. subsystems_half_len: each subsystem's place in the hull, [x to starboard, y forward] in half-lengths, as the mounts' are. aim_hit_penalty: the chance to hit a captain of side 0 gives up aiming at anything but the hull. retreat_below_hull_frac: a wingman told to retreat at 50 % or 25 % breaks off below that share of its hull. map_scales_km: the tactical map's ranges, the middle one first shown. objectives: a test scene that is won by disabling, not destroying (the Disable scene): the scenario, the ship to take intact and the subsystems to bring under the Disabled line (tuning.json status_disabled_below); destroying it fails the scene.
